title: POV: You Wake Up in Nan Madol — The Monumental Islets of Micronesia #shorts
hook_text: A CITY WAS BUILT ON ARTIFICIAL ISLETS
description:
Step into Nan Madol, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts

scenes.text: Channels of seawater separate compounds built from enormous basalt columns and coral fill.

scenes.text: The complex serves the rulers of the Saudeleur dynasty and their political and religious system.
